_comment: Q4 (plan-conversation-journal.md R3 + §7 q3, PO 2026-07-30): the simple version — three stages, no Miner leg. The traveller sits at (-20.6, -24.4) beside the tunnel mouth WITH a lamp he is done using; kill 6 kobolds (they nest north of the tunnel) and it is yours. Reward on the turn-in row (lampless-traveller.json): the Lantern aura + 700 XP. ⚑ L5b: with the 5 % Kobold drops deleted in the same chunk, that turn-in row is the ONLY source of Lantern in the world, and Lantern is the light the zone-1/2 tunnel is designed around — the quest is load-bearing content, pinned by TestContent_LanternHasAConversantSource. Abandon is safe (it re-offers; since N4/D4 the kill objective re-baselines on re-accept, so the 6 kobolds are due again). Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet — simple, direct wording only).
